en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are cultivated fields and a line of evenly spaced trees along a path. Beyond them lies a river with more trees on its banks. On the opposite bank stand numerous villas and townhouses on sloping ground, and, prominent on the right, a large neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire rising above the settlement. Forested hills and patchwork farmland stretch into the distance. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.
